Hello,

I saw your opening for a Graphic Designer & Video Editor at Provincial Group, and I was drawn to the opportunity to support showroom branding and digital campaigns for Mahindra's network here in Nagpur.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives, including marketing collateral, presentations, and print-ready files managed for bleed and color accuracy. I also built reusable design templates that cut turnaround time for repetitive corporate communications.

You can view my work in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, which includes projects demonstrating layout and visual hierarchy.

I am based in Nagpur and can start right away. Would you be open to a quick look at one of my layout case studies?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
